Orange Ginger Sesame Chicken
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, January 4, 2010 - 12:17am

Ingredients




1/4 cup Sesame seeds
8 Boneless chicken breast halves
Salt and pepper
6 tablespoons Butter
1 cup Fresh orange juice
1/2 cup Fresh lemon juice
 cup Mango chutney
2 tablespoons Chopped fresh ginger
2 tablespoons Rice vinegar
2 tablespoons Orange zest, (peel)
1 tablespoon Sesame oil
1/2 teaspoon Crushed red pepper

Preparation

1 Place sesame seeds in a small bowl. Salt and pepper chicken. Melt butter in skillet. Cook chicken breasts in butter about 3 minutes on each side. Whisk together marinade ingredients and pour into 9x13-inch baking dish. Place partially cooked chicken breasts in marinade and cover with foil. Bake at 400 degrees about 20 minutes. Serve warm or chilled. 2 Yield: 8 servings.
